def claim(
        self,
        *,
        worker_id: str,
        capabilities: list[str],
        lease_seconds: int | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        supported = {
            str(item or "").strip()
            for item in capabilities
            if str(item or "").strip()
        }
        if not supported:
            raise ValueError("worker must support at least one capability")
        duration = max(15, int(lease_seconds or self.default_lease_seconds))
        with self._lock, self._connect() as connection:
            self._transaction_lock(connection, "queue-admission")
            self._recover_expired(connection)
            now_epoch = time.time()
            worker = connection.execute(
                '\n                SELECT state\n                FROM execution_workers\n                WHERE worker_id = %s\n                ',
                (worker_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if worker is None:
                self._prune_stale_workers(
                    connection,
                    now_epoch=now_epoch,
                )
                connection.commit()
                return {"claimed": False, "reason": "worker_not_registered"}
            if worker["state"] != "active":
                self._prune_stale_workers(
                    connection,
                    now_epoch=now_epoch,
                )
                connection.commit()
                # A standby Worker waits for activation; a draining or offline
                # one was retired and leaves.
                return {
                    "claimed": False,
                    "reason": "worker_not_active",
                    "worker_state": str(worker["state"]),
                }
            connection.execute(
                '\n                UPDATE execution_workers\n                SET heartbeat_at = %s, updated_at = %s\n                WHERE worker_id = %s\n                ',
                (instant(now_epoch), execution_timestamp(), worker_id),
            )
            self._prune_stale_workers(
                connection,
                now_epoch=now_epoch,
            )
            candidates = connection.execute(
                "\n                SELECT execution_id, capability, actor, priority,\n                       request_json, created_at, checkpoint_json\n                FROM executions\n                WHERE status = 'queued'\n                  AND cancel_requested = 0\n                  AND available_at <= %s\n                ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at ASC\n                ",
                (instant(now_epoch),),
            ).fetchall()
            deferred_blocked = connection.execute(
                "\n                SELECT 1\n                FROM executions\n                WHERE status = 'queued'\n                  AND cancel_requested = 0\n                  AND available_at > %s\n                LIMIT 1\n                ",
                (instant(now_epoch),),
            ).fetchone() is not None
            eligible_candidates: list[Any] = []
            # A lost Worker's Provider work waiting to be interrupted makes no
            # model call: it passes quota, capacity and dispatch pacing.
            interrupt_candidates: list[Any] = []
            requests = {row["execution_id"]: _object(row["request_json"]) for row in candidates}
            admission = self._admission_snapshot(connection, list(requests.values()), now=now_epoch)
            blocked = set()
            for row in candidates:
                if row["capability"] not in supported:
                    continue
                interrupt_only = isinstance(_object(row["checkpoint_json"]).get("abandoned"), dict)
                reason = self._admission_reason(requests[row["execution_id"]], 0, interrupt_only, admission)
                if reason != "ready":
                    blocked.add(reason)
                    continue
                (interrupt_candidates if interrupt_only else eligible_candidates).append(row)
            quota_blocked = "quota_reserve" in blocked
            capacity_blocked = "capacity" in blocked
            dispatch_interval_blocked = "dispatch_interval" in blocked
            fair_candidates = self._fair_queue_order(
                connection,
                eligible_candidates,
            )
            candidate = (
                interrupt_candidates[0] if interrupt_candidates
                else fair_candidates[0] if fair_candidates else None
            )
            if candidate is None:
                connection.commit()
                return {
                    "claimed": False,
                    "reason": (
                        "quota_reserve" if quota_blocked else
                        "capacity"
                        if capacity_blocked
                        else (
                            "dispatch_interval"
                            if dispatch_interval_blocked
                            else (
                                "deferred"
                                if deferred_blocked
                                else "empty"
                            )
                        )
                    ),
                }
            execution_id = str(candidate["execution_id"])
            candidate_request = _object(candidate["request_json"])
            capacity_key = self._capacity_key(candidate_request)
            interrupt_only = bool(interrupt_candidates) and candidate is interrupt_candidates[0]
            dispatch_state = (
                {"interval_seconds": 0, "next_dispatch_at": 0} if interrupt_only
                else self._reserve_capacity_dispatch(
                    connection,
                    capacity_key,
                    now_epoch=now_epoch,
                )
            )
            token = secrets.token_hex(24)
            now = execution_timestamp()
            changed = connection.execute(
                "\n                UPDATE executions\n                SET status = 'claimed', owner_worker_id = %s, claim_token = %s,\n                    lease_expires_at = %s, available_at = 'epoch'::timestamptz,\n                    attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = %s\n                WHERE execution_id = %s AND status = 'queued'\n                ",
                (worker_id, token, instant(now_epoch + duration), now, execution_id),
            )
            if changed.rowcount != 1:
                raise PermissionError("execution claim ownership changed")
            if not interrupt_only:
                self._record_actor_dispatch(
                    connection,
                    actor=str(candidate["actor"]),
                    priority=int(candidate["priority"]),
                    now_epoch=now_epoch,
                )
            self._event(
                connection,
                execution_id,
                "claimed",
                {
                    "worker_id": worker_id,
                    "lease_seconds": duration,
                    "capacity_key": capacity_key,
                    "dispatch_interval_seconds": dispatch_state[
                        "interval_seconds"
                    ],
                    "next_dispatch_at": dispatch_state[
                        "next_dispatch_at"
                    ],
                },
            )
            row = connection.execute(
                'SELECT * FROM executions WHERE execution_id = %s',
                (execution_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            connection.commit()
        return {
            "claimed": True,
            "claim_token": token,
            "execution": self._row_payload(row),
        }

def claim_wait(
        self,
        *,
        worker_id: str,
        capabilities: list[str],
        lease_seconds: int | None = None,
        timeout_seconds: float = 15.0,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.1, float(timeout_seconds))
        with self._change_notifications(), self._claim_changed:
            while True:
                result = self.claim(
                    worker_id=worker_id,
                    capabilities=capabilities,
                    lease_seconds=lease_seconds,
                )
                if result.get("claimed") or result.get("reason") in {
                    "worker_not_active",
                    "worker_not_registered",
                }:
                    return result
                remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    return result
                self._claim_changed.wait(
                    self._next_claim_wake_seconds(remaining)
                )

def _assert_owner(
        row: Any | None,
        *,
        worker_id: str,
        claim_token: str,
    ) -> Any:
        if row is None:
            raise KeyError("execution not found")
        if (
            row["owner_worker_id"] != worker_id
            or row["claim_token"] != claim_token
        ):
            raise PermissionError("execution claim ownership changed")
        return row

    def start(
        self,
        execution_id: str,
        *,
        worker_id: str,
        claim_token: str,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self._lock, self._connect() as connection:
            self._transaction_lock(connection, f"execution:{execution_id}")
            row = self._assert_owner(
                connection.execute(
                    'SELECT * FROM executions WHERE execution_id = %s FOR UPDATE',
                    (execution_id,),
                ).fetchone(),
                worker_id=worker_id,
                claim_token=claim_token,
            )
            if row["status"] == "claimed":
                connection.execute(
                    "\n                    UPDATE executions\n                    SET status = 'running', updated_at = %s\n                    WHERE execution_id = %s\n                    ",
                    (execution_timestamp(), execution_id),
                )
                self._event(
                    connection,
                    execution_id,
                    "started",
                    {"worker_id": worker_id},
                )
            elif row["status"] != "running":
                connection.rollback()
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"cannot start execution in state {row['status']}"
                )
            connection.commit()
        return self.snapshot(execution_id)

    def heartbeat(
        self,
        execution_id: str,
        *,
        worker_id: str,
        claim_token: str,
        lease_seconds: int | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        duration = max(15, int(lease_seconds or self.default_lease_seconds))
        with self._lock, self._connect() as connection:
            self._transaction_lock(connection, f"execution:{execution_id}")
            row = self._assert_owner(
                connection.execute(
                    # Only ownership and state: request_json alone is often hundreds of KB,
                    # and this runs for every streamed event / heartbeat.
                    'SELECT execution_id, actor, status, owner_worker_id, claim_token, cancel_requested FROM executions WHERE execution_id = %s FOR UPDATE',
                    (execution_id,),
                ).fetchone(),
                worker_id=worker_id,
                claim_token=claim_token,
            )
            if row["status"] not in ACTIVE_STATUSES:
                connection.rollback()
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"cannot heartbeat execution in state {row['status']}"
                )
            now = execution_timestamp()
            connection.execute(
                '\n                UPDATE executions\n                SET lease_expires_at = %s\n                WHERE execution_id = %s\n                ',
                (instant(time.time() + duration), execution_id),
            )
            connection.execute(
                '\n                UPDATE execution_workers\n                SET heartbeat_at = %s, updated_at = %s\n                WHERE worker_id = %s\n                ',
                (instant(time.time()), now, worker_id),
            )
            connection.commit()
        return {"cancel_requested": bool(row["cancel_requested"])}

def checkpoint(
        self,
        execution_id: str,
        *,
        worker_id: str,
        claim_token: str,
        checkpoint: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = dict(checkpoint or {})

        with self._lock, self._connect() as connection:
            self._transaction_lock(connection, f"execution:{execution_id}")
            row = self._assert_owner(

            if row["status"] not in ACTIVE_STATUSES:
                connection.rollback()
                raise RuntimeError(

                )
            previous_handover = _object(row["checkpoint_json"]).get("worker_handover")
            if (
                isinstance(previous_handover, dict)

                payload = self._handover_checkpoint(payload, worker_id)
            elif (
                isinstance(previous_handover, dict)
                and previous_handover.get("turn_id") == payload.get("turn_id")
                and not payload.get("provider_completed")

                    "resumable": bool(payload.get("resumable")),

def activate_worker(
        self,
        worker_id: str,
        *,
        previous_worker_id: str = "",
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        target_id = str(worker_id or "").strip()
        previous_id = str(previous_worker_id or "").strip()
        if not target_id:
            raise ValueError("worker_id is required")
        if previous_id == target_id:
            raise ValueError("worker cannot replace itself")
        now = execution_timestamp()
        with self._condition, self._connect() as connection:
            self._transaction_lock(connection, "queue-admission")
            target = connection.execute(
                'SELECT state, build_id FROM execution_workers WHERE worker_id = %s',
                (target_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if target is None:
                connection.rollback()
                raise KeyError(target_id)
            if str(target["state"]) not in {"standby", "active"}:
                connection.rollback()
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"cannot activate worker in state {target['state']}"
                )
            previous_state = ""
            if previous_id:
                previous = connection.execute(
                    'SELECT state FROM execution_workers WHERE worker_id = %s',
                    (previous_id,),
                ).fetchone()
                if previous is not None and str(previous["state"]) not in {
                    "active",
                    "draining",
                    "offline",
                }:
                    connection.rollback()
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        f"cannot retire worker in state {previous['state']}"
                    )
                if previous is not None and str(previous["state"]) == "offline":
                    # It already left (a Worker another generation retired
                    # exits by itself); there is nothing left to retire.
                    previous_state = "offline"
                elif previous is not None:
                    previous_state = "draining"
                    connection.execute(
                        "\n                        UPDATE execution_workers\n                        SET state = 'draining', heartbeat_at = %s, updated_at = %s\n                        WHERE worker_id = %s\n                        ",
                        (instant(time.time()), now, previous_id),
                    )
            # Workers of the target's generation keep claiming side by side
            # (the Dev and Release pools run the same build); every other
            # generation stops claiming and hands its executions over, so a
            # publish that reloads both pools moves each execution only once.
            connection.execute(
                "\n                UPDATE execution_workers\n                SET state = 'draining', heartbeat_at = %s, updated_at = %s\n                WHERE state = 'active' AND worker_id != %s AND build_id != %s\n                ",
                (instant(time.time()), now, target_id, str(target["build_id"])),
            )
            connection.execute(
                "\n                UPDATE execution_workers\n                SET state = 'active', heartbeat_at = %s, updated_at = %s\n                WHERE worker_id = %s\n                ",
                    (instant(time.time()), now, target_id),
                )
            connection.commit()
            self._condition.notify_all()
            self._worker_control_changed.notify_all()
        return {
            "worker_id": target_id,
            "state": "active",
            "previous_worker_id": previous_id,
            "previous_state": previous_state,

        after_sequence: int = 0,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
        cancellation_requested: Callable[[], bool] | None = None,
        on_events: Callable[[list[dict[str, Any]]], None] | None = None,
        on_snapshot: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], bool | None] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Observe a durable execution; only explicit cancellation sends Stop."""
        deadline = (
            time.monotonic() + max(0.1, float(timeout_seconds))
            if timeout_seconds is not None
            else None
        )
        after_sequence = max(0, int(after_sequence))
        after_updated_at = ""
        cancel_sent = False
        last_control_plane_error = ""
        snapshot: dict[str, Any] = {}
        last_projected_snapshot: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        last_activity_signature: tuple[int, int] | None = None
        while deadline is None or time.monotonic() < deadline:
            remaining = (
                max(0.1, deadline - time.monotonic())
                if deadline is not None
                else 30.0
            )
            wait_seconds = min(30.0, remaining)
            try:
                # Business cancellation is local to this waiter; it does not
                # wake a Scheduler wait until we deliver the control request.
                # A quiet provider/tool must not hide Stop behind a 30s RPC.
                if not cancel_sent and cancellation_requested is not None:
                    if cancellation_requested():
                        self.cancel(
                            execution_id,
                            actor=actor,
                            reason="execution cancelled by caller",
                        )
                        cancel_sent = True
                    else:
                        wait_seconds = min(
                            wait_seconds, _CANCELLATION_CHECK_SECONDS,
                        )
                reply = self.client.request(
                    "execution.wait",
                    {
                        "execution_id": str(execution_id or ""),
                        "actor": str(actor or ""),
                        "after_sequence": after_sequence,
                        "after_updated_at": after_updated_at,
                        "timeout_seconds": wait_seconds,
                        "include_events": True,
                        "include_result": True,
                        "quiet_reply": True,
                    },
                    timeout=wait_seconds + 2,
                )
                last_control_plane_error = ""
            except (ExecutionServiceUnavailable, ExecutionResponseUnknown) as exc:
                # ExecutionService is the durable control plane. A socket
                # replacement does not say anything about the Worker or model
                # turn, so preserve the same execution identity and cursor
                # until the service is reachable again.
                last_control_plane_error = str(exc)
                retry_delay = 0.25
                if deadline is not None:
                    retry_delay = min(
                        retry_delay,
                        max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic()),
                    )
                if retry_delay > 0:
                    time.sleep(retry_delay)
                continue
            reply = reply if isinstance(reply, dict) else {}
            if reply.get("unchanged") is True:
                # Nothing changed since the last full snapshot; its events
                # were already handled.
                reply = (
                    {**snapshot, "events": []}
                    if snapshot
                    else dict(self.status(
                        execution_id,
                        actor=actor,
                        after_sequence=after_sequence,
                        include_events=True,
                        include_result=True,
                    ))
                )
            snapshot = reply
            terminal_status = str(snapshot.get("status") or "").strip().lower()
            if (
                terminal_status in TERMINAL_STATUSES
                and not _terminal_snapshot_has_matching_result(snapshot)
            ):
                # A business waiter may overlap another process finishing and
                # acknowledging the same job.  Do not project an incomplete
                # terminal observation: confirm against the canonical row so
                # a stale terminal projection cannot end a live Execution.
                snapshot = dict(
                    self.status(
                        execution_id,
                        actor=actor,
                        after_sequence=after_sequence,
                        include_events=True,
                        include_result=True,
                    )
                )
                confirmed_status = str(
                    snapshot.get("status") or ""
                ).strip().lower()
                if (
                    confirmed_status in TERMINAL_STATUSES
                    and not _terminal_snapshot_has_matching_result(snapshot)
                ):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "ExecutionService returned a terminal state without "
                        "its matching ExecutionResult"
                    )
            events = [
                dict(item)
                for item in snapshot.get("events") or []
                if isinstance(item, dict)
            ]
            if events:
                after_sequence = max(
                    after_sequence,
                    max(int(item.get("sequence") or 0) for item in events),
                )
                if on_events is not None:
                    on_events(events)
            projected_snapshot = {key: value for key, value in snapshot.items() if key != "events"}
            # A Provider activity (for example "Command started") is appended to
            # the shared activity log and announced only to the ExecutionService
            # the Worker reports to; Dev and Release share PostgreSQL, not memory.
            # A quiet tool changes neither events nor the row, so the growing log
            # itself is a change worth projecting.
            activity_signature = _execution_activity_signature(execution_id)
            if on_snapshot is not None and (
                events
                or projected_snapshot != last_projected_snapshot
                or activity_signature != last_activity_signature
            ):
                observed_snapshot = copy.deepcopy(projected_snapshot)
                if on_snapshot(dict(snapshot)) is not False:
                    last_projected_snapshot = observed_snapshot
                    last_activity_signature = activity_signature
            after_updated_at = str(
                (snapshot.get("scheduler") or {}).get("updated_at")
                or after_updated_at
            )
            if str(snapshot.get("status") or "") in TERMINAL_STATUSES:
                return snapshot
        if deadline is None:
            raise RuntimeError("unreachable execution wait state")
        raise ExecutionWaitTimeout(
            execution_id, snapshot=snapshot, after_sequence=after_sequence,
            control_plane_error=last_control_plane_error,

evidence.excerpt:
def acknowledge(self, execution_id: str, *, actor: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self._condition, self._connect() as connection:
            self._transaction_lock(connection, f"execution:{execution_id}")
            row = connection.execute(
                'SELECT actor, status, acknowledged_at FROM executions WHERE execution_id = %s',
                (execution_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None or str(row["actor"]) != str(actor or ""):
                connection.rollback()
                raise KeyError(execution_id)
            if str(row["status"]) not in TERMINAL_STATUSES:
                connection.rollback()
                raise RuntimeError("only terminal executions can be acknowledged")
            acknowledged_at = (iso_time(row["acknowledged_at"]) or "") or execution_timestamp()
            connection.execute(
                "\n                UPDATE executions\n                SET request_json = '{}', checkpoint_json = '',\n                    acknowledged_at = %s, updated_at = %s\n                WHERE execution_id = %s\n                ",
                (acknowledged_at, acknowledged_at, execution_id),
            )
            self._event(
                connection,
                execution_id,
                "acknowledged",
                {},
            )
            connection.commit()
        return self.snapshot(execution_id, include_result=False)

evidence.excerpt:
## 先理解一次模型执行

**一次模型执行**是从 Portal 接受一个模型请求，到得到完成、失败或取消结果的完整过程。它有一个稳定的 `execution_id`，形如 `execution-` 加 24 位小写十六进制。网络重连、服务滚动更新、Worker 换代都继续使用这个 ID，所以提交方可以把它保存在自己的业务记录里，之后随时找回这次执行。

一次执行依次经过这些对象：

- **请求（ExecutionRequest）**：提交方描述要做什么，包括提交者、提示词、服务类型（持续会话 `agent_session` 或一次性生成 `chat_completion`）、Provider、操作（例如新建会话、进行一轮对话、Fork、压缩、释放）、会话地址和业务归因信息。字段规则见 decision_6ad0384e020d。
- **队列**：已经保存在数据库中、等待执行进程领取的请求。**Scheduler**（持久调度器）拥有队列，按账号容量、优先级、提交者之间的公平性和同一会话串行的要求，决定下一条由谁执行。
- **Worker**：实际运行模型调用的进程。Worker 领取一条执行时，Scheduler 发给它一份**领取资格**（claim）：Worker ID、一个随机的领取令牌和一个到期时间（**租约**）。只有持有当前有效资格的 Worker 可以开始执行、续租、上报事件、保存恢复点或提交结果；资格失效后，旧 Worker 的任何写入都被拒绝。
- **Runtime（ExecutionRuntime）**：Worker 内按固定顺序完成一次执行的编排器：准备会话，记录输入，调用 Provider，保存恢复点，写入执行内容，最后更新会话地址。
- **Provider 会话与会话地址**：Provider 自己的 thread 或 session 称为 Provider 会话；Portal 用稳定的会话地址 `binding_id` 指向它，业务代码因此不依赖 Provider 内部 ID。两者的对应关系由 SessionManager 维护（decision_91eb3626d323）。
- **恢复点（checkpoint）**：Scheduler 为运行中的执行保存的恢复位置，说明 Provider 是否已经接收输入、是否已经完成，以及继续写入执行内容所需的最小状态。
- **AgentData**：保存输入、模型输出、工具调用、上下文和最终结果的内容存储（decision_b1ab45c4b3ec），回答“这次执行产生了什么”。Scheduler 的 PostgreSQL 回答“这次执行现在由谁运行、能否取消、是否需要恢复”。两边用 `execution_id` 对齐。
- **用量**：执行消耗的 token。AgentData 保存执行的唯一身份、生命周期、输入归属与单次执行最终报告的用量；Scheduler 按 UTC 小时累计用量账本，供 Home 页和运营查询使用（decision_f1331d57be89）。

## 设计点

### 提交与观察

- **业务代码通过 ExecutionService 客户端（facade）操作模型执行。** facade 是运行在调用方进程里的一个 Python 类，把提交、恢复、查询、等待、追加输入、取消、调整优先级、改换账号和确认终态包装成方法。Portal Web 和 LineageService 都不在自己的进程里创建 Provider 运行时。
- **提交重试始终使用原来的 `execution_id`。** 服务暂时不可达时，facade 每 250 毫秒用同一个 ID 重新提交，直到服务回应。Scheduler 在解析账号和准备会话前比较首次提交时保存的请求摘要：相同 ID、相同内容返回已有记录；相同 ID、不同内容被拒绝。之后调整优先级或路由不改变这个摘要。
- **恢复一次执行前先核对业务预期。** `resume` 读取已有执行，可以同时检查关联 ID（`correlation_id`）和执行能力（例如 `agent_session:codex`），任一不符就失败，调用方不会误接管另一项业务的执行。
- **等待可以跨服务重连。** facade 把长时间等待拆成每段最长 30 秒的服务端等待，记住事件游标和 Scheduler 更新时间；服务暂时不可达时每 250 毫秒重连，继续等待同一个执行，不会新建执行。
- **只有调用方明确要求时才发送取消。** 调用方在等待时可以提供一个“业务是否已取消”的检查函数，facade 每 250 毫秒检查一次，结果为真时向原执行发送一次取消。等待到达调用方设置的总时限时，facade 抛出等待超时错误，附带最后一次快照和最后一次连接故障说明，不取消执行；执行继续在后台运行，调用方可以稍后再等。
- **状态快照的形状固定。** 快照始终包含 `execution_id`、`actor`、`status`、`request`、`events`、`result`、`error`、`scheduler` 八个顶层字段。查询时可以不要事件或结果，这时对应字段为空，`request` 与 `scheduler` 摘要始终保留。
- **终态快照必须带匹配的结果。** 等待返回的终态快照缺少对应的执行结果时，facade 再读一次权威状态；仍然缺少时报告协议错误，不把这种快照当作执行结束。

### 通知、健康与运行环境

- **变化通知只提示“有变化”，读者以快照为准。** 执行状态变化时，服务通过 NATS 发布 `portal.execution.changed.<execution_id>`；Worker 上报活动事件时发布 `portal.execution.activity.<execution_id>`；提交终态时如果带有用量，再发布 `portal.projection.changed.token-usage.snapshot` 提示 Home 刷新用量。发布失败不影响已经写入 PostgreSQL 的状态，收到通知的一方重新读取快照。
- **健康查询只读。** 它返回服务实例、构建版本、Scheduler、通知连接和 AgentData 的当前状态，不回收租约、不清理 Worker，也不修正 AgentData 中的状态。
- **获得授权的 Resident shell 可以访问 Portal 数据库。** 一次执行同时满足以下条件时，支持本地 shell 的 Provider 在启动该 Resident 的 shell 前传入 `PORTAL_DATABASE_URL`：请求的 `metadata.business_type` 为 `resident`，`metadata.resident_id` 等于执行的 `agent_id`，权限配置为 `owner`（完整文件访问），`metadata.filesystem_scope.mode` 为 `A`。连接串只在运行时交给 shell，不写入持久请求；其他执行不接收这个变量。连接串从服务环境读取，缺少时读取 `portal-postgres.env`。
- **ExecutionService 也是 HATG ISA 的拥有服务。** 模型接口的登记与调用、执行账号的查看与调度设置、用量查询这几类指令在 ExecutionService 中执行（decision_4527448ad07f）。它们与上面的执行 RPC 共用同一个 Unix socket，通过 `instruction.execute` 方法进入（decision_96a887d83e8a）。

## 持久事实与临时协调

agent.executions 保存唯一的 execution_id 与执行生命周期；agent.execution_inputs 保存合并或追加到该执行的输入。Resident 开始准备即建立 Execution，准备失败仍留下终态。Scheduler 的队列行保存领取资格、租约、重试及事件投递工作，使用同一 execution_id；它与 AgentData 的状态在同一数据库事务中提交。

Lineage 的 resident_execution_work 协调准备、提交、观察、停止和确认，resident_execution_release_work 保存未完成的释放。工作完成后清理这两类协调行，执行历史由 AgentData 保留。不另建 job、turn、mailbox round 或 invocation 的 Resident 执行账本。Trigger Path 自己保存事件起因、步骤与对 Execution 的引用，Resident 输出触发的新 Event 建立新的路径。

## 组件及其责任

| 组件 | 负责什么 | 状态保存在哪里 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 业务调用方（LineageService、Portal Web、后台脚本） | 组织业务对象和提示词，保存业务记录与 `execution_id` 的关联，解释结果并写回业务状态 | 各自的业务存储 |
| ExecutionService 客户端 facade | 提交、恢复、查询、等待、追加输入、取消、调整优先级、改换账号、确认终态，并处理 socket 短暂中断 | 不保存持久状态 |
| ExecutionServiceServer | 独立进程中的 RPC 服务端，持有 Scheduler、提交准备器、账号观察器、通知发布器，并运行定期维护 | 进程内 |
| ExecutionPreparation（提交准备器） | 入队前校验请求，为持续会话解析执行账号和路由 | 不保存 |
| Scheduler | 队列、优先级、领取资格、租约、取消、Worker 登记、运行中输入、账号额度状态和小时用量账本 | Scheduler PostgreSQL |
| AccountMonitor | 定时读取各执行账号的额度、余额和历史用量（decision_d40f59f5508f） | 进程内样本；历史用量存 PostgreSQL |
| ExecutionWorker | 领取执行，维持心跳和控制循环，调用 Runtime，用当前领取令牌提交结果 | 只持有当前资格的进程内状态 |
| WorkerManager | 启动新一代 Worker、检查就绪、切换领取权、让旧 Worker 退出并处理遗留资格（decision_075f66430606） | 健康文件 |
| ExecutionRuntime | 规定会话准备、Provider 调用、内容写入和完成提交的顺序 | 不保存 |
| SessionManager | 把会话地址解析为 Provider 会话，执行成功后更新对应关系（decision_91eb3626d323） | AgentData |
| Provider Adapter | 把统一请求翻译成 Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code、DeepSeek Harness 或 Chat Completion 的原生协议、事件和中断（decision_425e428410e0） | 不保存 |
| Agent Harness | 在一次 Provider 调用周围增加上下文治理、工具治理和恢复能力（decision_5c62deb8253a） | 插件自己的产物与效果账本 |
| AgentDataProjector | 把输入、Provider 观察、工具、压缩、输出与用量写入 AgentData；生命周期由接纳协调者和 Scheduler 负责 | AgentData |

## RPC 传输和进程边界

每个部署的 socket 位于 `<实例根目录>/<实例名>/execution-service.sock`，环境变量 `PORTAL_EXECUTION_SERVICE_SOCKET` 可以改写本实例的路径。服务端创建 socket 前删除遗留文件，创建后设置权限 `0660`，关闭时删除。

一次连接交换一行 JSON。请求是 `{id, method, params}`；成功响应返回相同 `id`、`ok=true` 和 `result`；失败响应返回相同 `id`、`ok=false`，以及异常类名和消息。服务端为每个连接开一个线程处理；客户端提前断开时，服务端结束这次响应，不再尝试写入。`instruction.execute` 是例外：非流式指令返回一行，流式指令每批一行，最后一行表示结束（decision_96a887d83e8a）。

客户端的连接阶段最多等 5 秒，等待响应默认 30 秒，调用方可以按方法设置，最小 0.1 秒。只有连接尚未建立时的失败属于服务不可用（`ExecutionServiceUnavailable`），客户端可以改试另一实例的 socket。连接建立后发生读取超时、断开、空响应、非法 JSON 或响应 ID 不匹配时，客户端报告结果未知（`ExecutionResponseUnknown`），传输层不重放请求。facade 对只读等待和带稳定执行 ID 的幂等提交继续重试；其他写入由调用方查询权威状态或使用其幂等回执收敛。

远端的 `KeyError`、`ValueError`、`PermissionError` 在客户端还原为同类异常；领取资格已经属于别人时还原为 `ExecutionClaimOwnershipLost`；其他异常还原为 `RuntimeError`。

这组 RPC 信任同机进程和 socket 文件权限。请求中的 `actor` 由可信的 Portal 内部调用方提供，用来说明这次执行归谁所有；能连接 socket 的本地进程可以伪造它。面向不可信客户端的逐请求认证需要作为共享 RPC 安全机制统一增加。

服务启动时由 Scheduler 持有唯一的账号目录与容量设置，ExecutionPreparation 复用该目录并管理会话准备。执行结果反序列化与终态、用量字段、时间格式集中在协议模块中。

evidence.claim: 历史快照，仅作追溯；现行行为以当前源码和 Design 为准。提交、只读观察、取消与确认的业务契约。
evidence.excerpt:
### 提交与观察

- **`execution.submit`**：接收完整请求，先按执行 ID 比较首次提交的请求摘要；只有新执行才解析执行账号和准备会话，再持久入队。相同 `execution_id` 与相同请求返回已有记录；相同 ID 与不同请求被拒绝。
- **`execution.status`**：参数为 `execution_id`、可选 `actor`、非负 `after_sequence`（只返回这个序号之后的事件），以及 `include_events`、`include_result`。`actor` 非空时必须等于执行所有者，否则按“不存在”处理；可信内部调用方可以传空 `actor`。返回八个固定字段的快照；关闭事件时 `events` 为空数组，关闭结果时 `result` 为空对象。
- **`execution.wait`**：参数为 `execution_id`、必填 `actor`、事件游标 `after_sequence`、Scheduler 更新时间 `after_updated_at`、单段等待秒数（限制在 0.1 到 60 秒，默认 30），以及事件和结果开关。出现新事件、更新时间变化、进入终态或本段超时时返回快照。等待不续租，也不改变执行状态。服务端除了接收本进程的即时通知，还监听 Scheduler 数据库的变化通知，并每 5 秒复查一次，所以另一个进程（例如另一个部署）提交的终态也能及时唤醒等待者。facade 的分段、重连和取消行为见 decision_25eb93d803a4。
- **`execution.token_usage`**：读取小时用量账本，参数和返回见 decision_f1331d57be89。它不接收 `actor`，也不改变任何执行。

### 运行中的控制

- **`execution.input.append`**：接收完整的追加输入。必须显式携带 `schema=dirtybase.execution-input-control.v1`，缺少或版本不同直接失败。它为非终态的、支持运行中输入的一轮对话新增一条 `pending` 控制，并唤醒 Worker。权限在对应 ISA 入口按动态策略检查；这里校验执行状态、Provider 能力与目标轮次。终态、不支持的 Provider、非 `turn` 操作或当前一轮已经改变都会失败。
- **`execution.turn_settings.update`**：接收本轮设置更新，规则同上。
- **`execution.input.get`**：参数为 `control_id` 和 `agent_id`，返回这条控制的持久回执。控制不存在时返回 `null`；控制存在但所属执行缺失或 `agent_id` 不符时以 `KeyError` 拒绝，不返回其他执行者的回执。重复读取不会重复投递。
- **`execution.cancel`**：参数为 `execution_id`、必填 `actor`、可选 `reason`、可选 `performed_by`（实际执行取消的人，默认等于 `actor`）和可选 `queued_only`。`actor` 必须等于执行所有者，`performed_by` 记录实际操作者。排队中的执行立即变为 `cancelled`；已领取或运行中的执行记下取消请求并通知 Worker。`queued_only=true` 时只取消排队中的执行，其他状态原样返回。重复取消保持已有的终态或标志。
- **`execution.priority`**：参数为 `execution_id`、必填 `actor`、新的 `priority` 和可选 `performed_by`（记录实际操作者）。只能修改排队中的执行；Scheduler 同时更新结构化优先级和持久请求，并追加 `priority_changed` 事件。
- **`execution.route.reassign`**：参数为 `execution_id`、必填 `actor`、目标 `backend_route_id` 和可选 `performed_by`。Scheduler 只允许改动排队中的持续会话执行；调用方负责确认该请求尚未使用 Provider 会话，执行账号的适配器同时改写路由和相关运行选项，执行 ID 保持不变，并追加 `route_changed` 事件。Resident 切换账号时用它移动还没开始的排队工作。
- **`execution.acknowledge`**：参数为 `execution_id` 和必填 `actor`。只有所有者的终态执行可以确认，非终态确认失败。确认后 Scheduler 清空保存的请求和恢复点，保留完整的执行结果，让重连或同时观察的一方仍能读到结果。确认可以重复，不改变结果；确认后超过 24 小时的记录被清理。

evidence.claim: Worker登记、领取、续租、交接、checkpoint与终态接口。
evidence.excerpt:
## Worker 与 Scheduler RPC

### Worker 登记与代际切换

- **`scheduler.worker.register`**：提交 `worker_id`、`build_id`、非空能力列表、进程 ID 和初始状态（`standby`、`active`、`draining` 或 `offline`；必须显式提供）。同一 Worker ID 不能改绑到另一个构建；已经是 `draining` 或 `offline` 的 Worker 不能通过重新登记回到 `standby` 或 `active`。
- **`scheduler.worker.activate`**：激活目标 Worker，可以声明 `previous_worker_id`。目标必须是 `standby` 或 `active`；Scheduler 在一个事务里把前任和其他 `active` Worker 改为 `draining`，再把目标改为 `active`，并唤醒领取和控制等待。
- **`scheduler.worker.state`**：只能把 Worker 改为 `draining` 或 `offline`，不能用来激活。
- **`scheduler.worker.handover`**：只接受 `draining` 或 `offline` 的 Worker，在旧进程退出后处理它遗留的领取资格。已领取未开始的执行回到队列；运行中的执行只有恢复点标记可恢复时才回到队列，并保留计划交接信息。返回回到队列和无法移交的执行 ID，随后把 Worker 置为 `offline`。
- **`scheduler.worker.unregister`**：只有 `offline` 且没有已领取或运行中工作的 Worker 可以删除；不存在时返回 `removed=false`。

### 领取、开始和续租

- **`scheduler.claim.wait`**：按 Worker 状态、能力、延迟时间、同一会话串行、账号额度保护、容量、派发间隔、优先级和提交者公平性领取执行。等待时间限制在 0.1 到 30 秒，默认 15 秒；租约默认 90 秒，最短 15 秒。没有可领取执行时返回空结果和原因：`worker_not_registered`、`worker_not_active`、`quota_reserve`、`capacity`、`dispatch_interval`、`deferred` 或 `empty`。
- **`scheduler.start`**：当前 Worker 用领取令牌把 `claimed` 原子地改为 `running`。令牌已经失效的 Worker 收到“领取资格已变化”。
- **`scheduler.heartbeat`**：当前持有者延长 Worker 和这次执行的租约，返回是否已请求取消（`cancel_requested`）。运行中输入和交接指示通过 `scheduler.control.wait` 获取。

### 计划内交接准备

**`scheduler.handover.prepare`** 接收 `execution_id`、`worker_id`、`claim_token`，要求调用方仍是这次已领取或运行中执行的有效持有者，否则按资格错误拒绝。准备不释放资格，也不把执行改为终态。

| 情况 | 返回与持久效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 已请求取消 | `ready=false`、`cancel_requested=true`，按用户取消处理 |
| 恢复点不可恢复 | `ready=false`、`cancel_requested=false`，不猜测 Provider 是否已经接收，不安排 `continue` |
| 恢复点可恢复 | 先保存交接恢复点，再返回 `ready=true`、`cancel_requested=false` 和 `interrupt_required` |

Provider 声明 `handover_keeps_turn` 的 turn 操作保持原生轮次运行，`interrupt_required=false`；其余已有轮次且尚未完成的操作按能力决定中断。交接恢复点记下原 Worker、这一轮的 ID 和原生会话 ID，恢复点发生变化时追加 `handover_prepared` 事件；重复准备不会产生第二个执行。

Worker 得到 `ready=true` 后按 `interrupt_required` 解除跟随或中断，等旧跟随和相关控制调用都返回后，逐项调用 `scheduler.requeue` 释放资格。Provider 已经完成时，直接用恢复点补交结果，不发多余的中断或 `continue`。准备和释放各自检查取消，两者之间到达的停止请求不会被覆盖。

### 可恢复控制与运行中输入

- **`scheduler.requeue`**：当前持有者把恢复点已标记可恢复的执行放回队列。它释放资格、保留恢复点，`retry_after_seconds` 限制在 0 到 3,600 秒。恢复点不可恢复时失败。
- **`scheduler.control.wait`**：当前持有者长轮询控制信息，等待时间限制在 0.1 到 60 秒，默认 30。返回 `cancel_requested`、`handover_requested`，以及待投递的 `turn_controls`（追加输入和本轮设置更新）。处于 `draining` 的 Worker 即使没有待投递输入也会收到交接指示；待投递的控制不交给即将退休的 Worker，由新持有者恢复后按原来的轮次规则处理。
- **`scheduler.input.complete`**：当前持有者把一条待投递控制标为 `delivered` 或 `failed`（默认错误为 `delivery_failed`）。重复完成保持已有状态。

控制长轮询和输入完成等待同样监听数据库变化通知并每 5 秒复查，另一个部署提交的取消、交接和追加输入不会等到长轮询超时才被发现。复查不改变资格、租约、投递或终态的判断规则。

### 事件、恢复点与容量

- **`scheduler.event`**：当前持有者为执行追加事件。普通事件得到严格递增的序号，并追加到这次执行的活动日志；`provider_event` 先递归脱敏。特殊类型 `token_usage_delta` 改为记入用量账本，`details` 中必须有稳定的 `event_id`（decision_f1331d57be89）。
- **`scheduler.checkpoint`**：当前持有者写入非空恢复点，Scheduler 同时追加 `checkpointed` 事件，记录 Provider、会话、轮次和是否可恢复。旧持有者迟到的恢复点和新持有者对原一轮的恢复都保留交接标记，Provider 接收新的一轮后才清除。Provider 已完成的恢复点允许新 Worker 跳过重复调用。
- **`scheduler.capacity.reassign`**：新会话在 Provider 故障切换确定实际路由后，调整执行占用的容量键。只有当前持有者、且会话还没有被固定到原路由时有效。
- **`scheduler.capacity.configure`**、**`scheduler.quota_overrides.configure`**：账号调度设置与 binding 例外，见 decision_d40f59f5508f。
- **`scheduler.quota_overrides.forget`**：按 `binding_ids` 删除已移除执行者的额度例外，重复删除无副作用。

### `scheduler.finish`

当前持有者提交执行结果。结果中的 `execution_id` 必须匹配，`status` 只能是三个终态之一。已经请求取消时，Scheduler 强制保存为 `cancelled`。同一个事务里保存结果、错误和剩余用量，清除持有者、令牌和租约，把未投递的运行中输入标为失败，并唤醒等待者。

evidence.claim: 业务actor与Worker令牌不同；无凭据句与固定实现冲突。
evidence.excerpt:
## 权限依据与错误

业务控制和 Worker 写入使用两套依据。`status`、`wait`、`input`、`cancel`、`priority`、`route.reassign`、`acknowledge` 比较请求中的 `actor` 与执行所有者；`performed_by` 记录实际操作者。Worker 方法依据 Worker 状态、Worker ID、领取令牌和租约。`actor` 不能代替领取令牌，领取令牌也不授予业务所有者的权限。

这组 RPC 运行在权限为 `0660` 的同机 Unix socket 上，请求本身不带凭据。`actor` 由可信的 Portal 内部调用方提供；能连接 socket 的本地进程可以伪造它。

evidence.claim: 共享持久调度、账号容量、actor公平、binding串行和持有资格。
evidence.excerpt:
### 持久与共享

- **提交先写入数据库，再等待 Worker。** 服务或 Worker 重启时，已经入队的执行仍在数据库中，不会因为进程内存丢失而消失。
- **Dev 与 Release 共用一个 Scheduler 数据库。** 两个部署有各自的 Unix socket，但共享总容量、公平记录和账号额度状态。

### 容量与节奏

- **每个容量分区独立限流。** 分区的并发上限默认取账号声明的值（没有账号的分区默认 8），可以按账号设置为 1 到 256。
- **同一分区相邻两次派发之间随机等待一段时间。** 默认在 2 到 6 秒之间均匀抽取，可以按账号设置为 0 到 3600 秒的范围；会话释放分区固定为 0 秒。每次成功派发时重新抽取一次。
- **账号处于额度保护时，这个账号上的排队执行暂停领取。** 保护规则见 decision_d40f59f5508f。

### 顺序与公平

- **高优先级先于低优先级；同一优先级内，先在提交者之间轮转，再按每个提交者自己的提交顺序派发。** 一次成功领取才会推进这个分区的派发时间和这个提交者的公平记录；只是查看候选或被容量挡住，不消耗轮次。
- **同一会话的执行串行运行。** 带有同一个非空 `binding_id` 的持续会话执行，前一条处于领取或运行中时，后一条留在队列里，防止两轮对话同时改写同一个 Provider 会话。

### Worker 与写入资格

- **只有处于激活状态的 Worker 可以领取新工作。** `standby` 等待激活；`draining` 停止领取，主动交接手里的工作，并在每项工作安全释放前保留资格；`offline` 不参与派发。
- **每次受保护的写入都核对 Worker ID 和领取令牌。** 开始、续租、上报事件、保存恢复点、记录用量和提交终态都要求调用方仍是当前持有者；旧代 Worker、重复 Worker 或超时的请求都被拒绝。持有者写入与租约回收、交接锁定同一执行行，领取更新还核对排队状态及实际更新行数；资格检查和更新之间不能被另一个实例夺走所有权。这项规则称为 fencing（写入资格隔离）。
- **Worker 或租约失效后，按执行阶段和恢复点决定去向。** 不能证明可以安全重做的 Provider 外部动作，不会被当作可以重试。

### 维护

- **健康查询只读。** 持续的恢复工作由 ExecutionService 每 5 秒一次的维护完成：回收过期租约和失联 Worker，并修正 AgentData 中的执行状态。

evidence.claim: Close阈值、未知读数、运行中豁免和binding例外。
evidence.excerpt:
### 额度保护

Resident 的接单开关只表达人工输入控制。额度保留、等待与恢复由 Execution Scheduler 负责；账号详情分别显示人工打开/关闭数量和 Scheduler 额度状态。

- **账号额度进入保护状态后，这个账号上的自动工作暂停。** 新鲜的剩余额度或余额小于等于正数阈值时，账号状态变为 `reserved`：它的排队执行不再被领取，快照中的排队原因显示 `quota_reserve`；它正在运行、且没有 binding 例外的执行被请求取消，取消原因记为 `quota_reserve`。
- **修改 Close 阈值时已经在运行的工作继续完成。** 新阈值从下一次派发开始生效：仅在阈值数值或单位实际改变时，把这个账号上已领取或正在运行的执行记入豁免名单，之后的额度采样也不会因为额度保护取消它们；修改之后才开始的执行仍按上一条规则受额度保护。
- **读数未知时，百分比账号暂停，余额账号不因此暂停。** 百分比账号读数过期、读取失败或窗口不完整时，自动工作同样暂停；余额账号只有明确读到低于阈值的余额才会进入保护，余额未知不会被当成零。
- **已经进入保护的账号只有取得新鲜的恢复读数才会解除。** 读取失败或仅仅过了额度重置时间，都保持 `reserved`。解除后，原来排队的工作按原顺序继续领取；被取消的执行保持取消，不会自动重放。
- **Resident 被人工打开接单时，会为它当前的会话记录一条 binding 例外；再被人工关闭时，这条例外改为停用。** 例外只作用于这个 binding，不会传给其他 Resident 或 Fork 出的新会话。修改阈值不会撤销已有例外。
- **创建或迁移模型会话前，调用方检查目标账号还有剩余额度。** 目标账号的 Close 阈值为正数时，`quota_reserve.remaining`（原币金额或百分比）必须新鲜且严格大于零，否则不能创建新会话；阈值为 0 时不做这项检查。准备中的临时会话、取消迁移和保留原会话的流程见 decision_c47a13e8b962。

evidence.claim: 代际激活与逐项解除跟随、释放和接回同turn。
evidence.excerpt:
## 一次计划内滚动交接

```text
部署发送 SIGHUP
      │
      ▼
新 Worker 以 standby 登记 → 健康文件就绪 → Scheduler 原子激活
                                      │
                          旧 Worker 进入 draining
                                      │
                        为每项执行持久准备交接
                                      │
                    解除跟随，并等待旧控制调用结束
                                      │
                  逐项释放领取资格，原执行回到 queued
                                      │
                      新 Worker 领取同一个 execution
                                      │
                               核对原来那一轮
                         ┌────────────┴────────────┐
                         ▼                         ▼
                 已经完成：补交结果         仍在运行：接回原轮次
```

WorkerManager 是一个常驻循环，每 0.5 秒检查一次：有没有收到重新加载请求、激活中的 Worker 是否还活着、正在退休的 Worker 是否已经退出，并更新自己的健康文件。部署通过向它发送 SIGHUP 请求换代。收到请求时，如果 WorkerManager 自己的源码（`worker_manager.py`）已经改变，它让所有 Worker 进入退休流程后退出，由 systemd 用新代码重启；否则在当前进程内启动新一代 Worker 完成替换。换代失败时记录日志，当前一代继续服务。

显式重启通过管理接口向 WorkerManager 主进程发送 `SIGUSR1`，普通 reload 仍发送 `SIGHUP`。管理入口先核对健康文件的 `manager_pid` 与 systemd 当前主进程一致，并确认 `explicit_restart_supported=true` 和原 Worker ID；旧 manager 尚未加载该处理器时拒绝请求，须先通过正常部署加载，不能直接给旧进程发送未支持的信号。管理入口在既有健康及构建版本检查之外，等待当前健康 Worker ID 与请求前的 ID 不同，才确认完成，并返回 `worker_restart` 中的 `previous_worker_id`、新 `worker_id`、`build_id` 和 `manager_pid`。受理请求、同代健康或浏览器刷新均不代表 Worker 已更换；超时保留验证失败，不能返回假成功。该回执证明新 Worker 激活，不保证旧 Worker 全部执行已交接完毕；验证某任务恢复还须沿原 `execution_id` 核验实际 owner 与接管事实。

## 准备、释放与接管

旧 Worker 通过 `scheduler.handover.prepare` 在有效资格下保存交接恢复点。只有恢复点可以使用时结果才是“就绪”；还没有输入已接收或可恢复的证据时，不会把原任务改写成猜测性的 `continue`。用户已经取消时，按取消流程收尾。

交接恢复点记下原 Worker、Provider 会话和精确的那一轮。Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code 和 DSH 的计划交接均保留 Provider 中正在运行的一轮，准备结果为“无需中断”；旧 Worker 解除跟随，新 Worker 接回同一 turn。不能用 `turn/interrupt` 代替解除跟随：模型的工具等待被中断，不证明原生子进程或副作用已经停止。真正的用户停止仍走精确中断；已经发出的控制请求须返回后才释放资格，避免迟到的请求影响新的一轮。Runtime 保留执行内容和恢复位置，计划移交不产生失败或取消终态。

每项执行退出后，旧 Worker 调用 `scheduler.requeue`，保留原请求和恢复点，释放原领取令牌。Scheduler 在释放事务中再次检查取消；已经有停止请求且 Provider 仍可能运行时，先进入待中断队列，由下一位 Worker 中断后收敛为 `cancelled`；没有 Provider 工作时直接取消。新 Worker 用新的令牌恢复同一个执行，旧 Worker 之后的写入都会被拒绝。

Codex Adapter 先在同一个路由和 thread 上核对原来那一轮：仍在运行就通过 `resume_turn` 接回，已经完成就经既有实时投影入口补交真实结果，均不发送新输入。无法核对原轮次或工具交付时，Adapter 不发送继续输入，延期计入持久的无进展恢复预算。原生命令后来完成也不能证明结果已交给模型；连续三次无新工作后报告恢复耗尽，保留原执行和工具证据。Provider 接收新的一轮后，原交接标记被清除。跨代准备状态和 Goal 的处理见 decision_3e8c2a7f91d4。

Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code 和 DSH 的交接不中断这一轮（Provider 目录 `handover_keeps_turn`）。这一轮由 Provider 自己的进程运行（Claude 守护进程、Kimi Code 服务、DSH bridge），同一会话和 turn_id 的一轮可以换一个 Worker 继续：

- **Codex 的跟随边界。** Codex 客户端以 `detach_requested` 区分计划移交与用户取消。已开始的 Worker 动态工具调用先回传真实结果；进入解除跟随状态后不再接新工具请求，也不向模型返回虚构的取消结果，由 App Server 将待处理请求交给新订阅者。原生命令继续属于 App Server 的原 turn。新 Worker 按真实 command/item ID 重放同 turn 的已完成结果到同一个 Agent trace，不按正文或 native_id 去重，不另设历史写入入口。成功通过资格校验重新排队后，Worker 返回 `requeued`，不会把本地解除跟随标志误报为资格被抢走。

- **旧 Worker 离开。** 准备结果为“无需中断”，交接恢复点的交接标记带 `turn_kept_running`。Claude 和 DSH 的旧 Worker 只在两条消息之间断开连接；Kimi 的旧 Worker 停止轮询，不中止这一轮。旧 Worker 已经开始执行的工具调用先执行完并回传结果；交接开始后才到达旧 Worker 的工具调用不执行，原样交给下一个 Worker 执行（`ToolCallHandedOver`），不会以“已取消”失败返回模型。Adapter 报告可恢复的延期，Worker 照常 `requeue`。
- **新 Worker 接回。** 新 Worker 用同一个 turn_id 接回这一轮（这一轮是 Provider 错误后的续接时，用续接那一轮的 ID）。Claude 守护进程和 DSH bridge 把这一轮接到新连接上，DSH 只按 turn_id 认这一轮，不再比对请求内容；Kimi 的新 Worker 继续跟随同一个 prompt，并照常处理审批、提问和工具状态。接回时不发送任何输入，只记 `worker_handover_continuing`（`input_delivery=kept_running`）。
- **空档里不丢东西。** 没有 Worker 连接期间，Claude 守护进程保留这一轮的事件（最多 5000 条），DSH bridge 从会话日志补发新 Worker 没收到的事件；Portal 工具调用等待新 Worker，最多 3 分钟（Kimi 的工具调用等待新 Worker 的工具网关出现）。
- **空档里的停止。** 释放领取或排队期间收到停止时，执行不直接结束，按丢失 Worker 的方式标记 `abandoned`：下一个 Worker 先中断这一轮，再以取消结束，所以 Portal 显示空闲时 Provider 也已停下。新 Worker 接回前发现执行已停止，就不再接回。

# SessionManager 与 Provider Binding

一个 Resident 可以和模型连续对话很多轮，靠的是模型服务供应方（Provider）那边保存着的会话：Codex 叫 thread，Claude Code、Kimi Code 叫 session。Portal 不直接把业务数据挂在 Provider 的会话 ID 上，而是给每段会话一个自己的稳定地址 `binding_id`，再记下这个地址当前指向哪个 Provider 会话。这条对应关系称为 **Provider Binding**。

def _insert_segment(
        connection: Any,
        *,
        segment_id: str,
        segment_type: str,
        content: object,
        started_at: str,
        finished_at: str,
        status: str,
        created_by_actor_ref: str,
        performed_by_actor_ref: str,
        content_type: str,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any],
        created_by_agent_id: str,
        execution_id: str,
    ) -> str:
        if segment_type not in SEGMENT_TYPES:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid Segment type: {segment_type}")
        clean_id = str(segment_id or "").strip()
        if not clean_id:
            raise ValueError("Segment identity is required")
        at = str(finished_at or started_at or utc_now())
        clean_content_type = str(content_type or "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
        raw = _content_bytes(content, clean_content_type)
        payload_ref, sha256 = AgentDataStore._payload(
            connection, raw, clean_content_type, at
        )
        forbidden = {"hidden_from_chat", "show_in_chat", "send_to_ai", "native_id"}
        if forbidden.intersection(metadata):
            raise ValueError("Segment metadata cannot store consumer eligibility or transport aliases")
        metadata_json = canonical_json(dict(metadata))
        existing = connection.execute(
            'SELECT * FROM segments WHERE segment_id = %s', (clean_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if existing is not None:
            content_identity = (
                str(existing["segment_type"]),
                str(existing["content_ref"]),
                str(existing["content_type"]),
                str(existing["metadata_json"]),
            )
            if content_identity != (
                segment_type,
                payload_ref,
                clean_content_type,
                metadata_json,
            ):
                raise SegmentIdentityConflict(clean_id)
            return clean_id
        connection.execute(
            '\n            INSERT INTO segments(\n                segment_id, segment_type, started_at, finished_at,\n                status, created_by_actor_ref, performed_by_actor_ref,\n                content_ref, content_sha256, content_type,\n                metadata_json, created_by_agent_id, execution_id\n            ) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)\n            ',
            (
                clean_id,
                segment_type,
                instant(str(started_at or "")),
                instant(str(finished_at or "")),
                str(status or "completed"),
                str(created_by_actor_ref or ""),
                str(performed_by_actor_ref or ""),
                payload_ref,
                sha256,
                clean_content_type,
                metadata_json,
                str(created_by_agent_id or ""),
                str(execution_id or ""),
            ),
        )
        return clean_id

def transform_agent_segments(
        self, agent_id: str, source_ids: Sequence[str], *, segment_id: str,
        content: Any, actor_ref: str, operation_id: str, operation_type: str,
        segment_type: str = "input", content_type: str = "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, execution_id: str = "",
        created_at: str = "",
    ) -> str:
        """Atomically replace consumed occurrences, retaining immutable ancestry.

        Only this Agent's sequence changes. A Fork already holding a source keeps
        it. Identical text in another occurrence has no bearing on replacement.
        """
        sources = list(dict.fromkeys(source_ids))
        if not sources:
            raise ValueError("A transformation needs source Segment identities")

        def write(connection: Any) -> str:
            sequence_id = self._locked_trace(connection, agent_id, actor_ref)
            members = connection.execute(
                "SELECT ordinal, segment_id FROM sequence_segments WHERE sequence_id=%s "
                "AND segment_id=ANY(%s) ORDER BY ordinal", (sequence_id, sources),
            ).fetchall()
            if not members:
                replay = connection.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM sequence_segments WHERE sequence_id=%s AND segment_id=%s",
                    (sequence_id, segment_id),
                ).fetchone()
                if replay:
                    return segment_id
                raise ValueError("Transformation sources are outside the current trace")
            if len(members) != len(sources):
                raise ValueError("Transformation must consume all its current sources")
            first = self._read_segment_row(connection, members[0]["segment_id"])
            facts = {**first["metadata"], **dict(metadata or {})}
            # Message identity is attached to the occurrence, not its old text.
            at = str(created_at or utc_now())
            self._insert_segment(
                connection, segment_id=segment_id, segment_type=segment_type,
                content=content, content_type=content_type, metadata=facts,
                 started_at=at, finished_at=at,
                status="completed", created_by_actor_ref=first["created_by_actor_ref"],
                performed_by_actor_ref=actor_ref, created_by_agent_id=agent_id,
                execution_id=execution_id or first["execution_id"],
            )
            for source_id in sources:
                relation_id = stable_segment_id("transform", operation_id, source_id, segment_id).replace("segment_", "relation_", 1)
                connection.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO segment_relations VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING",
                    (relation_id, "transformed_from", source_id, segment_id,
                     operation_id, operation_type, "1", at, actor_ref, "{}"),
                )
            # Preserve the first position; gaps are harmless and retain cursors.
            connection.execute(
                "DELETE FROM sequence_segments WHERE sequence_id=%s AND segment_id=ANY(%s)",
                (sequence_id, sources),
            )
            connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO sequence_segments(sequence_id,ordinal,segment_id) VALUES (%s,%s,%s)",
                (sequence_id, int(members[0]["ordinal"]), segment_id),
            )
            self._touch_sequence(connection, sequence_id, actor_ref)
            chat_position_index.refresh_sequence(connection, sequence_id)
            return segment_id

        return self.database.write(write)

def agent_context_snapshot(self, agent_id: str, *, before_message_id: str = "", through_message_id: str = "", through_turn_id: str = "", provider_session_ref: str = "") -> dict[str, Any]:
        """The Agent's own effective window, including a Fork with no session yet.

        Walk backwards to the last compaction/reset. Read payloads only for the
        retained window. Execution receipts do not determine trace membership.
        Delivery excludes its current input with before_message_id.
        """
        with self.database.snapshot() as connection:
            return self._agent_context_snapshot(connection, agent_id, before_message_id=before_message_id, through_message_id=through_message_id, through_turn_id=through_turn_id, provider_session_ref=provider_session_ref)

    def _agent_context_snapshot(self, connection: Any, agent_id: str, *, before_message_id: str = "", through_message_id: str = "", through_turn_id: str = "", provider_session_ref: str = "") -> dict[str, Any]:
        trace = self._agent_trace(connection, agent_id)
        if trace is None:
            raise KeyError(f"Agent trace not found: {agent_id}")
        sequence_id = str(trace["sequence_id"])
        first = 1
        before = None
        if provider_session_ref:
            session_owner = connection.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM executions WHERE provider_session_ref=%s AND agent_id=%s "
                "UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM agent_operations WHERE session_ref=%s AND agent_id=%s "
                "AND kind='context_received' LIMIT 1",
                (provider_session_ref, agent_id, provider_session_ref, agent_id),
            ).fetchone()
            # Inherited messages retain their original session provenance. Its
            # delivery receipts belong to the source, not this independent trace.
            window = self._session_window(connection, provider_session_ref, agent_id) if (
                session_owner is not None
            ) else None
            if window and window[0] == sequence_id:
                first = max(first, window[1])
                before = window[2] + 1
        if before_message_id:
            member = self._chat_member(connection, sequence_id, before_message_id)
            if member is None:
                raise ValueError("Context input boundary is not in the Agent trace")
            before = int(member["ordinal"])
        if through_message_id:
            member = self._chat_member(connection, sequence_id, through_message_id)
            if member is None:
                raise ValueError("Fork cutoff message is not in the Agent trace")
            # The selected input and following responses form a trace interval.
            # A recorded Provider turn can group appended inputs, but old traces
            # remain usable without any Execution or Provider session record.
            target = self.trace_rows(connection, sequence_id, first=int(member["ordinal"]), limit=1)[0]
            target_turn = str(target["provider_turn_id"] or "")
            cutoff = connection.execute(
                "SELECT MIN(m.ordinal) AS ordinal FROM sequence_segments m JOIN segments segment USING(segment_id) "
                "LEFT JOIN executions execution USING(execution_id) "
                "WHERE m.sequence_id=%s AND m.ordinal>%s AND (segment.segment_type='compaction' OR ("
                "((segment.segment_type='input' AND COALESCE(segment.metadata_json::jsonb->>'role','user')='user') OR "
                "(segment.segment_type='harness' AND segment.metadata_json::jsonb->>'kind'='effective_provider_input' "
                "AND segment.metadata_json::jsonb->>'role'='user')) "
                f"AND (%s='' OR COALESCE({PROVIDER_TURN_SQL},'')<>%s)))",
                (sequence_id, member["ordinal"], target_turn, target_turn),
            ).fetchone()
            before = int(cutoff["ordinal"]) if cutoff["ordinal"] is not None else None
            reset = connection.execute(
                "SELECT MIN(p.ordinal) AS ordinal FROM operation_positions p JOIN agent_operations o USING(operation_id) "
                "WHERE p.sequence_id=%s AND p.ordinal>%s AND o.kind IN ('context_reset','provider_context_reset')",
                (sequence_id, member["ordinal"]),
            ).fetchone()
            if reset["ordinal"] is not None:
                before = min(before, int(reset["ordinal"])) if before is not None else int(reset["ordinal"])
        if through_turn_id:
            cutoff = connection.execute(
                "SELECT MAX(m.ordinal) AS ordinal FROM sequence_segments m JOIN segments segment USING(segment_id) "
                "LEFT JOIN executions execution USING(execution_id) WHERE m.sequence_id=%s "
                f"AND {PROVIDER_TURN_SQL}=%s",
                (sequence_id, through_turn_id),
            ).fetchone()
            if cutoff["ordinal"] is None:
                raise ValueError("Fork cutoff has no recorded context in this Agent trace")
            before = int(cutoff["ordinal"]) + 1
        boundary = connection.execute(
            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(p.ordinal),0) AS ordinal FROM operation_positions p "
            "JOIN agent_operations o USING(operation_id) WHERE p.sequence_id=%s "
            "AND o.kind IN ('context_reset','provider_context_reset') "
            "AND (%s::bigint IS NULL OR p.ordinal < %s)", (sequence_id, before, before),
        ).fetchone()
        first = max(first, int(boundary["ordinal"]) + 1)
        rows = []
        while True:
            page = self.trace_rows(connection, sequence_id, first=first, before=before,
                                   newest_first=True, limit=256)
            stop = False
            for row in page:
                rows.append(row)
                if row["segment_type"] == "compaction":
                    stop = True
                    break
            if stop or len(page) < 256:
                break
            before = int(page[-1]["ordinal"])
        rows.reverse()
        selected = []
        for row in rows:
            metadata = json.loads(row["metadata_json"])
            if metadata.get("kind") in PROVIDER_ONLY_KINDS | {"system_instructions"}:
                continue
            selected.append(row)
        segments = self._read_segment_rows(connection, [str(row["segment_id"]) for row in selected])
        for item, row in zip(segments, selected):
            item["provider_turn_id"] = str(row["provider_turn_id"] or "")
        return {"segments": segments, "empty_context": not segments}

CHAT_PREDICATE = "jsonb_typeof(metadata_json::jsonb -> 'message') = 'object'"
CHAT_SEGMENT = "jsonb_typeof(segment.metadata_json::jsonb -> 'message') = 'object'"
# Turn/changes/subagent cards describe work in the UI; they cannot answer an
# input or supersede its textual/structured reply merely by arriving later.
REPLY_SEGMENT = """NOT (segment.metadata_json::jsonb->'message' ? 'harness_input') AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(segment.metadata_json::jsonb#>'{message,parts}', '[]'::jsonb)) part
 WHERE part->>'type' IN ('native_turn','resource_changes','subagent_run','tool_call','tool_result')
)"""


# OFFSET 0 keeps each content lookup correlated to the selected occurrence.
# Flattening these lookups made PostgreSQL scan the global content table even
# for a small chat page, including large payloads belonging to other Agents.
CONTENT_POLICY = """WITH
content_payloads AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM payloads),
payloads AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM content_payloads
 UNION ALL
 SELECT operation_id, '', octet_length(convert_to(data_json::jsonb->>'content','UTF8')),
        'text/plain; charset=utf-8', convert_to(data_json::jsonb->>'content','UTF8'), created_at
 FROM agent_operations WHERE kind='notice'
),
content_segments AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT segment_id, segment_type, started_at, finished_at, status,
        created_by_actor_ref, performed_by_actor_ref, content_ref, content_sha256,
        content_type, metadata_json, created_by_agent_id, execution_id FROM segments
),
segments AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT content_segments.*, COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata_json::jsonb#>>'{message,created_at}','')::timestamptz, finished_at, started_at) AS created_at FROM content_segments
 UNION ALL
 SELECT operation_id, data_json::jsonb->>'segment_type',
        created_at, created_at, 'completed', data_json::jsonb->>'created_by_actor_ref', 'portal',
        operation_id, '', 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
        (data_json::jsonb->'metadata')::text, agent_id, COALESCE(data_json::jsonb->>'execution_id',''), created_at
 FROM agent_operations WHERE kind='notice'
),
"""
FINAL_MEMBERS = """
 SELECT member.* FROM sequence_segments member
 JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT metadata_json FROM content_segments WHERE segment_id=member.segment_id
     AND jsonb_typeof(metadata_json::jsonb->'message')='object' OFFSET 0
 ) current_message ON TRUE
 WHERE current_message.metadata_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'final_answer' OR NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM LATERAL (
     SELECT segment_id FROM content_segments candidate
     WHERE jsonb_typeof(candidate.metadata_json::jsonb->'message')='object'
       AND candidate.metadata_json::jsonb#>>'{message,message_id}'=current_message.metadata_json::jsonb#>>'{message,message_id}'
     OFFSET 0
   ) previous_message
   JOIN sequence_segments earlier ON earlier.segment_id=previous_message.segment_id
     AND earlier.sequence_id=member.sequence_id AND earlier.ordinal<member.ordinal
 )
"""
# Start with the selected trace's positions. The lateral OFFSET 0 prevents a
# per-Resident count from scanning all notices before applying sequence_id.
NOTICE_MEMBERS = """ UNION ALL
 SELECT position.sequence_id, position.ordinal, position.operation_id
 FROM operation_positions position JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT 1 FROM agent_operations operation
   WHERE operation.operation_id=position.operation_id AND operation.kind='notice' OFFSET 0
 ) notice ON TRUE
"""
READ_POLICY = CONTENT_POLICY + "sequence_segments AS NOT MATERIALIZED (" + FINAL_MEMBERS + NOTICE_MEMBERS + ")\n"
# Activity and input counters observe events, not the choice of one final reply
# for a rendered message. They use ordinary membership indexes directly.
ACTIVITY_POLICY = CONTENT_POLICY + "sequence_segments AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM sequence_segments" + NOTICE_MEMBERS + ")\n"


class ConversationConnection:
    def __init__(self, connection: Any, *, collapse_final_replies: bool = True):
        self.connection = connection.connection if isinstance(connection, ConversationConnection) else connection
        self.policy = READ_POLICY if collapse_final_replies else ACTIVITY_POLICY

    def execute(self, statement: str, parameters=None):
        clean = statement.lstrip()
        if "segments" in clean and clean.upper().startswith(("SELECT", "WITH")):
            if clean.upper().startswith("WITH RECURSIVE "):
                statement = self.policy + "SELECT * FROM (" + clean.rstrip().rstrip(";") + ") portal_chat_read"
            elif clean.upper().startswith("WITH "):
                statement = self.policy + ", " + clean[5:]
            else:
                statement = self.policy + clean
        return self.connection.execute(statement, parameters)

    def __getattr__(self, name: str):
        return getattr(self.connection, name)

def _record_session_input_acceptance(
        cls, connection: Any, execution: Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> bool:
        """Persist the first accepted turn independently of Execution retention."""
        session_ref = str(execution["provider_session_ref"] or "")
        turn_id = str(execution["provider_turn_id"] or "").strip()
        agent_id = str(execution["agent_id"])
        if not session_ref or not turn_id:
            return False
        if cls._session_input_acceptance(connection, session_ref, agent_id) is not None:
            return False
        session = connection.execute(
            'SELECT provider FROM provider_sessions WHERE provider_session_ref = %s',
            (session_ref,),
        ).fetchone()
        if session is None or session["provider"] != execution["provider"]:
            raise ValueError("Session input acceptance requires the matching Provider Session")
        at = utc_now()
        put_operation(connection, operation_id=cls._session_input_acceptance_id(session_ref, agent_id),
            kind="input_accepted", agent_id=agent_id, session_ref=session_ref, created_at=at,
            data={"schema": SESSION_INPUT_ACCEPTANCE_SCHEMA, "provider_session_ref": session_ref,
                  "agent_id": agent_id, "provider_turn_id": turn_id,
                  "evidence_execution_id": str(execution["execution_id"]), "recorded_at": at})
        return True

def finish_execution_in(self, connection: Any, execution_id: str, *, status: str,
                            finished_at: str = "", usage: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
                            provider_turn_id: str = "", only_if_running: bool = False) -> bool:
        """Finalize in a transaction whose search path addresses Agent tables."""
        clean_status = str(status or "").strip()
        if clean_status not in {"completed", "failed", "cancelled"}:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid terminal Execution status: {clean_status}")
        row = connection.execute(
            'SELECT * FROM executions WHERE execution_id = %s FOR UPDATE',
            (str(execution_id or ""),),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise KeyError(execution_id)
        desired_finished_at = instant(finished_at or row["finished_at"] or utc_now())
        desired_turn_id = str(provider_turn_id or row["provider_turn_id"] or "")
        desired_usage = canonical_json(dict(usage or {}))
        if only_if_running and row["status"] != "running":
            return False
        if str(row["status"]) in {"completed", "failed", "cancelled"}:
            # Maintenance enumerates running rows before reading Scheduler.
            # A Worker may have finalized this row in that interval.
            if only_if_running:
                return False
            reported = json.loads(str(row["usage_json"] or "{}"))
            # The Scheduler's count is added after the Worker's terminal fact.
            reported.pop("accounted", None)
            current = (
                str(row["status"]),
                row["finished_at"],
                str(row["provider_turn_id"]),
                canonical_json(reported),
            )
            desired = (
                clean_status,
                desired_finished_at,
                desired_turn_id,
                desired_usage,
            )
            if current != desired:
                raise ValueError("Execution terminal fact cannot be changed")
            self._record_session_input_acceptance(connection, row)
            if row["final_message_id"] is None:
                self._refresh_finished_execution_pointer(connection, str(execution_id or ""))
            return False
        connection.execute(
            '\n                UPDATE executions\n                SET finished_at = %s, status = %s, usage_json = %s,\n                    provider_turn_id = %s\n                WHERE execution_id = %s\n                ',
            (
                desired_finished_at,
                clean_status,
                desired_usage,
                desired_turn_id,
                str(execution_id or ""),
            ),
        )
        self._record_session_input_acceptance(
            connection, {**dict(row), "provider_turn_id": desired_turn_id},
        )
        self._refresh_finished_execution_pointer(connection, str(execution_id or ""))
        return True

    def record_execution_output(self, execution_id: str, *, usage: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
                                provider_turn_id: str = "") -> None:
        """Persist Provider output metadata; the scheduler owns the terminal outcome."""
        def write(connection):
            row = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM executions WHERE execution_id=%s FOR UPDATE", (execution_id,)).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise KeyError(execution_id)
            if row["status"] in {"completed", "failed", "cancelled"}:
                return
            turn = provider_turn_id or row["provider_turn_id"]
            connection.execute("UPDATE executions SET usage_json=%s,provider_turn_id=%s WHERE execution_id=%s",
                               (canonical_json(dict(usage or {})),turn,execution_id))
            self._record_session_input_acceptance(connection,{**dict(row),"provider_turn_id":turn})
        self.database.write(write)

def ensure_provider_session(
        self,
        *,
        provider: str,
        backend_route_id: str,
        backend_session_id: str,
        agent_id: str,
        actor_ref: str,
        source_backend_session_id: str = "",
        source_backend_route_id: str = "",
        context_agent_id: str = "",
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Record a Provider session, the first time it is seen.

        A native fork (``source_backend_session_id``) starts with its source's
        current context; the trace of ``context_agent_id`` (the Agent that will
        work in it; by default ``agent_id``) marks that inherited context, so
        that the session's context read from the trace begins with it.  The
        context_received operation marks the first inherited trace member;
        the content must already belong to that Agent's trace.
        """

        clean_provider = str(provider or "").strip()
        clean_route = str(backend_route_id or "").strip()
        clean_session = str(backend_session_id or "").strip()
        if not clean_provider or not clean_session:
            raise ValueError("Provider Session identity is required")
        digest = hashlib.sha256(
            f"{clean_provider}\0{clean_route}\0{clean_session}".encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()[:32]
        session_ref = f"provider_session_{digest}"

        def write(connection: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
            existing = connection.execute(
                'SELECT 1 FROM provider_sessions WHERE provider_session_ref = %s',
                (session_ref,),
            ).fetchone()
            at = utc_now()
            if existing is None:
                clean_source = str(source_backend_session_id or "").strip()
                inherited: list[str] = []
                if clean_source:
                    source = connection.execute(
                        'SELECT provider_session_ref FROM provider_sessions '
                        'WHERE provider = %s AND backend_route_id = %s AND backend_session_id = %s',
                        (clean_provider, str(source_backend_route_id or clean_route), clean_source),
                    ).fetchone()
                    if source is None:
                        raise KeyError(
                            f"Provider Session source is not recorded: {clean_source}"
                        )
                    inherited = self._session_context_ids(
                        connection, str(source["provider_session_ref"]),
                        agent_id=str(context_agent_id or agent_id or ""),
                    )
                connection.execute(
                    'INSERT INTO provider_sessions(provider_session_ref, provider, backend_route_id, '
                    'backend_session_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)',
                    (session_ref, clean_provider, clean_route, clean_session, at, at),
                )
                marking_agent = str(context_agent_id or agent_id or "").strip()

def complete(
        self,
        request: ExecutionRequest,
        session: RuntimeSession,
        backend_session_id: str,
        *,
        backend_route_id: str = "",
        context_fingerprint: str = "",
        context_attached: bool = False,
        context_injected_at: str = "",
        harness_tool_names: Iterable[object] = (),
    ) -> None:
        """Record the turn's session; an injection counts from when it was sent.

        ``context_injected_at`` is the time the turn's injected parts were
        planned, before the Provider ran it: a compaction during the turn
        compacted them, so it is later than the injection.
        """
        if session.mode == "stateless" or not session.binding_id:
            return
        if (
            request.operation == "release"
            and bool(request.runtime_options.get("delete_binding_on_release"))
        ):
            self.release_session(
                session.binding_id, expected_provider_session_ref=session.provider_session_ref,
            )
            return
        if not backend_session_id:
            return
        route_id = str(backend_route_id or session.backend_route_id or "")
        if (
            session.backend_route_id
            and backend_route_id
            and session.backend_route_id != backend_route_id
            and not session.is_new_backend_session
        ):
            raise ValueError("Backend changed route for an existing session")
        injection_count = session.context_injection_count
        injected_at = session.context_injected_at
        fingerprint = session.context_fingerprint
        if context_attached:
            injection_count += 1
            injected_at = context_injected_at or utc_now()
            fingerprint = context_fingerprint
        self.bind_session(
            session.binding_id,
            provider=request.provider,
            backend_route_id=route_id,
            backend_session_id=backend_session_id,


            context_fingerprint=fingerprint,
            context_injected_at=injected_at,
            context_injection_count=injection_count,
            harness_tool_names=clean_string_tuple((
                *session.harness_tool_names,
                *tuple(harness_tool_names or ()),
            )),
        )

def begin(
        self,
        request: ExecutionRequest,
        session: RuntimeSession,
        *,
        created_at: str = "",
        recovery: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        agent_id = request.agent_id
        has_provider_input = request.operation in {"turn", "generate"}
        accepted_at = str(created_at or utc_now())
        input_segment_id = (
            stable_segment_id("execution-input", request.execution_id)
            if has_provider_input
            else ""
        )
        projection = _Projection(
            request=request,
            session=session,
            agent_id=agent_id,
            input_segment_id=input_segment_id,
            effective_input_segment_id=input_segment_id,
            provider=request.provider,
            backend_session_id=session.backend_session_id,
            backend_route_id=session.backend_route_id,
        )
        with self._lock:
            if request.execution_id in self._active:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"Agent data projection already active: {request.execution_id}"
                )
            self._active[request.execution_id] = projection
        execution_started = False
        try:
            self.store.begin_execution(
                execution_id=request.execution_id,
                agent_id=agent_id,
                actor_ref=request.actor,
                provider=request.provider,
                started_at=accepted_at,
            )
            execution_started = True
            if not has_provider_input:
                return
            metadata = {
                "role": "user",
                "source": "human_prompt",
                "kind": "provider_input",
                "title": request.actor or "User message",
                "author": request.actor,
            }
            with self.store.database.read() as connection:
                current = connection.execute(
                    "SELECT segment.segment_id FROM agents agent JOIN sequence_segments member ON member.sequence_id=agent.trace_sequence_id "
                    "JOIN segments segment USING(segment_id) WHERE agent.agent_id=%s AND segment.execution_id=%s "
                    "AND segment.segment_type='input' AND segment.metadata_json::jsonb->>'kind' IN ('provider_input','effective_provider_input') "
                    "ORDER BY member.ordinal LIMIT 1", (agent_id, request.execution_id),
                ).fetchone()
            if current:
                projection.effective_input_segment_id = str(current["segment_id"])
                projection.persisted_segments.add(projection.effective_input_segment_id)
                return
            content = (request.metadata.get("fork_context_input") or {}).get("prompt", request.prompt)
            portal_message_id = _input_message_id(request)
            source = self.store.chat_message(agent_id, portal_message_id) if portal_message_id else None
            if source:
                self.store.transform_agent_segments(
                    agent_id, [source["segment_id"]], segment_id=input_segment_id,
                    content=content, metadata=metadata, actor_ref=request.actor,
                    operation_id=request.execution_id, operation_type="provider_input.compose",
                    execution_id=request.execution_id, created_at=accepted_at,
                )
            else:
                self.store.put_segment(
                    segment_id=input_segment_id, segment_type="input", content=content,
                    started_at=accepted_at, finished_at=accepted_at, status="completed",
                    created_by_actor_ref=request.actor, performed_by_actor_ref=request.actor,
                    metadata=metadata, created_by_agent_id=agent_id, execution_id=request.execution_id,
                )
                self.store.append_agent_segments(agent_id, [input_segment_id], actor_ref=request.actor)
            projection.persisted_segments.add(input_segment_id)
        except BaseException:
            with self._lock:
                if self._active.get(request.execution_id) is projection:
                    self._active.pop(request.execution_id, None)
            if execution_started:
                self.store.finish_execution(request.execution_id, status="failed")
            raise
